scope: Frozen Binance USD-M native 1x/2x September account; 1,586 V1.7 funded parents; original admission and exit paths; no November two-leg/funding-adjusted account.

source.minute_volume: column 7 quote volume in USDT; column 5 base volume

limits.cap_basis: fraction times median quote volume from exactly the preceding 60 complete Binance USD-M 1m bars; actual funded parent entry notional is capped at this value.
limits.same_coverage_control: Uncapped account restricted to parents with a complete, valid 60m window and strictly positive median; no later replacements.
limits.unknown: Missing archives, incomplete windows, price conflicts, or invalid volumes receive zero entry limit in constrained arms and remain separately counted.
limits.execution: Existing 9-slot shared-cash VectorBT account; frozen entry order/slot and exact child paths; market limits use native actual notional; 5bp extra adverse market slippage stress.
limits.fees: Frozen model maker 2bp / taker 5bp. Binance historical VIP-specific fee tier is not asserted.
limitations: Minute quote-volume median is a turnover proxy, not visible order-book depth or guaranteed fill capacity.
No minimum quantity, lot size, queue position, spread, nonlinear market impact, or Binance funding is modeled.
A complete entry H1 is checked against the frozen H1 source; those post-entry minutes are not inputs to the cap.
limits.margin_audit: The raw H1 `valid` flag is a conservative screen. See summary.margin_validation for native-minute stop-versus-trade/mark boundary ordering.

unrestricted.source: frozen original native 1x/2x account; replayed through VectorBT and cash/hourly reconciled

unrestricted_stress.source: frozen original +5bp market-fill stress; reused without re-running the baseline

reporting.cross_boundary_policy: A trade enters a year’s trade statistics only when both entry and exit are in that year. Period NAV starts from the last hourly NAV at or before the year boundary.

margin_validation.screen_semantics: The margin `valid` and negative-equity fields are the conservative H1 OHLC prefilter. A flagged H1 range is not itself an executed liquidation; read its per-arm checked_hours and this native-minute ordering audit.
margin_validation.minute_method: For flagged H1 bars, compare the actual USD-M 1m trade stop touch with both 1m traded-price and markPriceKlines maintenance-threshold touches; require the stop minute to be strictly earlier.
margin_validation.limitation: This resolves event ordering at one-minute resolution for the identified H1 flags. It does not model Binance account-specific maintenance tiers, liquidation fees, or sub-minute price paths.
